display_long_description:
**FlowGateVR** — from Immersive Science.

A voice-driven VR tool for exploring multichannel flow cytometry data on Meta Quest.

**AI Assistant**
- Ask questions about your loaded dataset by speaking naturally
- Query marker distributions, population statistics, and gating results
- Get answers tuned for biomedical researchers — not generic AI
- AI features improve automatically with no app update required

**3D visualization**
- Map any markers to X, Y, and Z axes (e.g., CD4 vs CD8 vs CD3)
- Switch axis assignments on the fly to explore different marker combinations
- Scatter, forward scatter, side scatter, fluorescent markers — all mappable
- Visualize tSNE or UMAP dimensionality reduction alongside original markers

**Multidimensional gating**
- Draw 3D gates to select cell populations
- Apply multiple gates with distinct colors
- Switch axes with gates preserved — refine populations across marker spaces
- Export gated subsets as CSV for follow-up analysis

**Your data, your way**
- Import compensated event CSV files (exported from FlowJo or similar)
- Side-load datasets via Meta Link, headset browser, or SideQuest
- Compatible with CyTOF and spectral cytometry data in CSV format

**Collaboration**
- Shared VR sessions with voice communication
- Co-navigate the same dataset in real time

Designed for immunologists, cell biologists, and cytometry core facility researchers.

**Need more performance?** A Windows desktop version is available for very large datasets. Contact support@immsci.com for details.
